story_text: As a user, I want registration to fail if I leave any field empty so that incomplete accounts are not created.

positive.title: Validate Registration with Empty Fields is not allowed
steps: 2. Attempt to submit the registration form with all fields empty.
positive.expected_result: The system should prevent registration and display an appropriate error message indicating that all fields are required.

positive.title: Validate no incomplete accounts are created when fields are left empty during registration
steps: 2. Attempt to submit the registration form with some fields empty.
positive.expected_result: The system should prevent registration and display an appropriate error message indicating that all fields are required.

negative.title: Validate the system's behavior when some fields are empty during registration from the API
steps: 1. Go to the API endpoint for registration.
2. Attempt to submit the registration request with some fields empty.
negative.expected_result: The system should prevent registration and display an appropriate error message indicating that all fields are required.

edge.title: Attempt to Register with spaces in the fields and Observe System's Response
steps: 2. Attempt to submit the registration form with spaces in the fields.
edge.expected_result: The system should prevent registration and display an appropriate error message indicating that all fields are required.

edge.title: Attempt registering with rapid repeated submissions with empty fields and observe system's response
steps: 2. Attempt to submit the registration form with empty fields multiple times in quick succession.
edge.expected_result: The system should prevent registration and display an appropriate error message indicating that all fields are required.
